title: urochloa ciliatissima
intro: Urochloa ciliatissima, commonly known as Brachiaria ciliatissima, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, thereby offering various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Urochloa ciliatissima include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
